summary: Iteration 8 tests all new features from the review request. Backend: 9/10 pytest cases pass. Frontend: 100% pass — every requested data-testid is present and behaves correctly (Anagrafica 3 new fields, secondo motore toggle, Report card-pagamenti with green/red pill button, toast confirmation, data_pagamento display). ONE HIGH-priority backend bug discovered: PUT /api/clienti/{id} silently overwrites `pagato` back to False when the payload does not include it, because ClienteCreate.pagato defaults to False and update_cliente() blindly merges False into the existing doc. Editing any client from Clienti page after marking it Pagato will clear the payment status.

minor.issue: Overwrites `pagato` back to False after a client has been marked paid via PATCH. Root cause: ClienteCreate.pagato has default False; update_cliente does `merged.update({k: v for k,v in data.items() if v is not None ...})` — pagato=False is not None so it overrides existing True. Same risk for data_pagamento but that field is None-by-default so it's preserved. Fix: (a) change ClienteCreate.pagato and data_pagamento to Optional[bool]=None / Optional[str]=None and filter None (already done for data_pagamento), OR (b) exclude 'pagato' and 'data_pagamento' from the merged update in PUT so they only change through /pagato endpoint.

rca_of_issue: PUT /api/clienti/{id} bug — server.py:527-577 update_cliente(). The Pydantic model ClienteCreate declares `pagato: Optional[bool] = False` (not None). When frontend saves a client edit through ClienteForm, it POSTs the client's current in-memory state which does NOT include pagato (ClienteForm state at line 22-35 has no pagato key, so form initializes it as undefined → JSON.stringify drops it → backend Pydantic defaults it to False). Since False is not None, the None-filter at line 572 keeps it, and merged['pagato'] becomes False, wiping the previous PATCH result. Repro: 1) Mark any client paid via Report page toggle. 2) Open Clienti page, click that client, click Save without changes. 3) Return to Report — button is red again. Fix in one line: change ClienteCreate.pagato default to None (or explicitly exclude pagato/data_pagamento from PUT merge).
